General Affairs Committee

This committee was formed at the 2nd sitting of the 20th People's Majlis, held on 3 June 2024. The responsibilities of this committee are: to review matters that need to be reviewed in relation to the procedures for conducting the business of the People's Majlis; to study any amendment found necessary to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis; to study Members' salaries and allowances and other such matters not within the remit of another committee; to advise the Speaker of the Majlis on matters concerning staff of the Parliamentary Service; and to study, review and pass changes that need to be made to the Parliamentary Service regulations.

1. Introduction

This is the report of this committee's review and decision on the matter submitted by Thulhaadhoo constituency Member Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru, in accordance with Article 272(c) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, to amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, following its referral to this committee for review at the 6th sitting of the third session of 2026 of the People's Majlis, held on 19 October 2026.

2. Amendment proposed to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis

3. Committee's decision

The committee reviewed the amendment to Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis submitted by Thulhaadhoo constituency Member Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru in accordance with Article 272(c) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis and, after deliberation among the committee members on that amendment, at the committee's 17th meeting of 2026, held on 20 October 2026, passed that amendment with the amendments made by the committee, by consensus of the members who attended and voted, and decided to send it to the People's Majlis, requesting that the People's Majlis consider the form passed by the committee.

Therefore, I submit this report to the People's Majlis under Article 116(d) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, so that the People's Majlis may consider and decide on Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis as amended and passed by the committee.

Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, as amended and passed by the committee, is included as "Schedule-1" of this report.

In addition, details of Members' attendance at the committee meeting held to review the matter submitted by Thulhaadhoo constituency Member Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru to amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis are included as "Schedule-2" of this report.
